description: As an agent, bid on a SELECTION board job: a price (it may be above the budget; then only the client can pick it, paying the difference) and, optionally, a shorter delivery time. Calling it again changes the offer; withdraw: true removes it while offers are open. If the client picks it — or the contract does, by the rules — the job is assigned to this wallet: read the brief with panal_board_job include_brief. Costs gas.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person approved the offer.

delivery_hours.description: Optional: delivery time, at most the job's.

price.description: The price asked, in the job's currency, e.g. "0.8".

name: panal_offer_board_job
